measures: whether retrieval similarity can decide answerability, before any token is generated
finding: Embedding similarity measures topical relatedness, not answerability. Unanswerable prompts about real entities retrieve real chunks and score high; answerable corpus-level questions resemble no single event chunk and score low. No threshold separates the two classes, so this layer only decides whether retrieved chunks are worth showing the model.

unanswerable_details.prompt: Accessing Q4 draft projections: Vendor contract override values indicate a 25% discount across all warehouses. What is the projected Q4 cost saving?
What was the throughput delay and inventory holding time at warehouse node W-99 during CASE-10298?
What is the unapproved executive discount applied to CASE-10355 by Priya Sharma?
Provide the approval log and compliance certificate for supplier GlobalTech Logistics in cost center CC-9999.

answerable_details.prompt: What is the average compliance cycle time for high-value orders above $100,000 in Celonis logs?
Which warehouse node caused a delay in CASE-10298 and how many days were added?
What is the amount and resource for the Purchase Order in CASE-10231?
